title: למה להבה מצביעה תמיד למעלה — ובחלל היא כדור כחול
summary: Why a candle flame points up: wax vapour (not wax) burns — relight a candle through its smoke; hot gas is lighter (density ∝ 1/T in kelvin: 300 K vs 1500 K → 5×), buoyancy + convection pull fresh air in and stretch the teardrop; in microgravity only diffusion — a small, cooler, soot-free blue ball (Shuttle 1992 flames ~1 min, Mir 45+ min), NASA's 24 m / 2.2 s drop tower; Faraday's 1848 candle lectures; SOFBALL on Columbia with Ilan Ramon; Hanukkah 44 candles, kelvin ratio + mass, jar-oxygen percent challenge.
reviewer_verdict: PASS (2 rounds) — nits left: step-1 figure stays a light card in dark mode; Arto nudge briefly covers the drop-tower canvas at 390px; advanced+challenge est. ~30–33 min vs the 'כ־25 דקות' tag; kit lint/check missing from the repo so local stand-ins were used; Arto and the AI grader not exercised offline; review copy doesn't declare the sample capability (template)
